title: Loomly
seoTitle: Loomly Social Media Management Tool Reviews with MarketJoy
metaDescription: Loomly is a social media management platform for content planning, team collaboration, approvals, publishing, scheduling, and analytics with MarketJoy.

faqs.a: Loomly is a social media management platform. It helps businesses, agencies, and creators plan, create, approve, and schedule content from a single dashboard.

faqs.q: Which social media platforms does Loomly support?
faqs.a: Loomly supports Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, X, Pinterest, etc.

faqs.q: Does Loomly support content approval workflows?
faqs.a: Yes, Loomly includes customisable approval workflows.

faqs.q: Can Loomly automate publishing on different media?
faqs.a: Yes, Loomly helps to automate publishing for platforms. It gives manual reminders for content formats that need help.

faqs.q: Does Loomly give analytics and reporting?
faqs.a: Yes, it provides analytics dashboards, engagement monitoring, audience insights, and downloadable performance reports.

content:
Loomly is a cloud-based social media management platform. It is made around visual content calendars, team collaboration, and publishing automation. The platform is designed for marketing teams, agencies, brands and content creators. In turn, Loomly serves as a centralised workspace. Overall, it helps for planning, creating, approving, scheduling and understanding social media content. This applies to multiple channels. 

The platform focuses more on collaboration and workflow management in the content lifecycle. Loomly has an intuitive interface, approval workflows, post previews and multi-brand workspace structure. It enables companies to maintain consistency. Simultaneously, they can streamline content production.

How does Loomly work?

Loomly streamlines the entire social media management process. It is done using a structured workflow. They work on planning, collaboration, publishing and performance monitoring. 

  • Content Planning and Organisation - Loomly has a dedicated workspace that creates separate calendars and workflows for different brands. At the same time, it identifies content opportunities using Content Ideation Tools and a centralised asset storage system. 
  • Content Creation and Optimisation- It makes a master post and customises it for each social network. In turn, users can adjust captions, hashtags, and other settings and post live reviews.
  • Team Collaboration and Approvals - The platform assigns, edits, and reviews rights for team members. It also includes approval workflows and feedback management.
  • Publishing and Automation- Loomly schedules and automatically publishes content on supported networks. 
  • Performance Monitoring - It manages comments, messages, and mentions from a unified inbox. At the same time, it has a dashboard that automates reporting.

Core Capabilities

Multi-Channel Content Optimisation

Loomly can customise and optimise content for different social networks using a single workflow.

Team Collaboration and Approval

It can streamline reviews, approvals, and stakeholder communication.

Asset and Content Management

The platform organises different content. It can include media assets, creative resources and content ideas in one place.

Automated Publishing and Scheduling

Loomly can schedule and distribute content efficiently. It is possible for multiple channels.

What makes Loomly different?

  • Collaboration-First Platform- Loomly is made around content planning, feedback, and approval workflows. 
  • Advanced Post Customisation- The platform enables platform-specific optimisation. It does so while maintaining a single content creation process. 
  • Built-in Approval Workflows- Loomly helps clients and stakeholders to review and approve content in the platform.

Conclusion

Loomly is a social media management platform. It is a collaboration-focused platform.  The platform helps companies with content planning, approval workflows, publishing, audience engagement, etc. This is done using a single visual workspace. 

Do you want to work on content planning and improve team collaboration? Loomly is your ideal solution. It is a one-stop solution for managing social media operations on multiple channels.
